profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Moov Financial
profile.summary: Experienced software developer focused on improving products for customers and development practices for the teams that make them.

positions.title: Lead Developer
positions.description:
- Developed new features and maintained an API used by payment acquirers to process credit, debit, ACH, and stored-value account transactions.
- Co-lead developer for implementation of EMVCo 3-D Secure version 2.
Part of a team that grew the total transaction amount processed from less than $1 billion (2017) to $7 billion (2021).
- Trained and mentored new and junior developers on product and SDLC best practices.
- Reduced dev time by multiple hours per week per developer by greatly simplifying product architecture and dependencies.
- C#, ReST, SOAP, SQL

positions.title: Software Developer (Business Applications Analyst)
positions.description:
- Designed and created industry-leading customer-facing data management website for laboratory proficiency testing.
- Part of a cross-departmental project to reduce turn-around time to customers from 21 days to 2 days, an industry first.
- Designed, created, and upgraded internal systems to improve efficiency company-wide, including: product delivery, data management, manufacturing, customer management, and application performance.
- Mentored junior programmers and led a team of offshore contract developers.
- C#, ASP.NET MVC, JavaScript, Knockout.js, jQuery, SQL, SQL Server Reporting Service, HTML, CSS, IIS management

positions.title: Owner
positions.description: Design and develop software for the iPhone and iPad using Objective-C, and the web using ASP.NET MVC and C#.

positions.title: Software Developer (Internal Systems Analyst)
positions.description: Primary developer and co-designer of an enterprise web application which integrates business functions for multiple departments. Maintains the software during its lifecycle. Communicates with clients to determine project requirements. Works primarily with Visual Basic .NET, ASP.NET, SQL, and SQL Server Reporting Services.

positions.title: Junior Programmer
positions.description: Designed, implemented upgrades, and troubleshot bugs in existing applications. Worked primarily with Delphi 5, SQL, and ASP.

skills.name: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS)
